short_description: A kneeling kick-back on a bench that isolates the glutes through hip extension.
how_to: Kneel on a bench with your hands on the edge for support.
Extend one leg back and up, squeezing the glute at the top.
Lower the leg with control without touching the bench.
Complete your reps, then switch to the other leg.
correct: Keep your hips square to the bench.
Squeeze your glute at the top of each rep.
Keep your lower back neutral.
Move with control throughout.
mistakes: Don't swing your leg to gain momentum.
Don't arch your lower back to lift higher.

short_description: A squat paired with a forward kick that works the legs, glutes and hip flexors.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat with your chest up.
As you rise, extend one leg forward in a controlled kick.
Return your foot to the floor and repeat, alternating the kicking leg.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes in the squat.
Keep your lower back controlled.
Keep your supporting leg stable during the kick.
Keep your core engaged.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't swing the kicking leg for momentum.

short_description: A standing single-leg drill that mobilises the hip joint through controlled circular movement.
how_to: Stand on one foot with a slight bend in your knee.
Lift the opposite knee to hip height.
Draw slow circles with your knee, rotating at the hip.
Complete your reps, then reverse the direction.
Switch legs and repeat.
correct: Keep your standing knee slightly bent.
Keep your torso upright.
Move slowly through the full range.
Breathe steadily.
mistakes: Don't lean your torso to compensate.

short_description: A dynamic cross-body touch-and-reach that improves coordination, balance and hip mobility.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your right foot and reach your left hand down toward your right foot.
Stand back up and extend your left arm overhead.
Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides with a smooth, controlled motion.
correct: Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge from your hips as you reach down.
Keep your back straight on the way down.
Move with control on each rep.
mistakes: Don't round your back to reach lower.
Don't rush between the touch and the reach.

short_description: A side-lying hip exercise that activates the glute medius by opening the knees like a clamshell.
how_to: Lie on your side with your hips and knees bent at about 45 degrees.
Stack your feet and keep them together.
Keeping your feet touching, lift your top knee as high as you comfortably can.
Lower with control and repeat.
Switch sides for the next set.
correct: Keep your pelvis stable throughout.
Keep your feet stacked and touching.
Move only at the hip, not the pelvis.
Control the lowering phase.
mistakes: Don't roll your hips back as you lift.
Don't let your top hip swing forward.

short_description: A rapid foot-shuffling drill that builds speed, agility and cardiovascular endurance.
how_to: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight forward onto the balls of your feet.
Shuffle your feet in place as fast as you can.
Keep your arms bent and moving naturally.
Maintain the pace for the full interval.
correct: Keep your knees bent throughout.
Keep your torso upright.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms relaxed.
mistakes: Don't pound your feet into the floor.
Don't lock your knees as you move.
Don't let your upper body tense up.

short_description: A standing quadriceps stretch that lengthens the front of the thigh.
how_to: Stand on one foot and bend the opposite knee behind you.
Grasp your ankle and draw your heel toward your glute.
Keep your knees together and your torso upright.
Hold the stretch and breathe steadily.
Switch legs and repeat.
correct: Keep your knees close together.
Keep your chest up and tall.
Breathe slowly throughout.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
mistakes: Don't arch your lower back to pull your heel closer.

short_description: A reverse table-top walk that strengthens the triceps, glutes and core.
how_to: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you and feet flat.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips off the floor.
Walk forward by moving your opposite hand and foot together.
Continue for the target distance or time, then reverse.
Keep your hips raised throughout.
correct: Keep your hips level as you move.
Keep your core engaged.
Keep your fingers pointing toward your feet.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.
mistakes: Don't let your hips sag to the floor.
Don't let your wrists collapse inward.

short_description: A wide-stance squat holding a dumbbell that targets the inner thighs, quads and glutes.
how_to: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width and toes turned outward.
Hold one dumbbell vertically with both hands in front of you.
Lower your hips straight down, keeping your torso upright.
Press through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the target reps.
correct: Keep your knees over your toes.
Keep your heels down throughout.
Keep your chest tall.
Keep your core engaged.
mistakes: Don't let your knees cave inward.
Don't lean forward as you lower.
Don't let your heels rise off the floor.

short_description: A crawling pattern with limbs reaching out in a star shape to build total-body coordination and core stability.
how_to: Start on all fours with your knees just off the floor.
Extend your right arm forward and your left leg back at the same time.
Hold briefly, then switch to the left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating while keeping your hips level.
Move slowly and with control throughout.
correct: Keep your hips parallel to the floor.
Keep your core braced throughout.
Extend fully on each reach.
Move with control, not speed.
mistakes: Don't let your hips rotate as you extend.
Don't let your lower back arch.
